The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f1aab59ba484eb8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 84-85. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: There are a function u and a vector field X, smooth on the one-sided manifold Mext, with the following properties. 84 1. u ≥ |X|g everywhere and u > 0 in Int Mext. For every q′ with 1/2 < q′ < min{q, 1}, u = b0 + O2(r−q′ ), X = bi ∂i + O2(r−q′ ). (10.3) 2. In the interior, sym ∇X = −uK, (10.4) ∆u = − div(K(X, ·)♯ ), (10.5) Hess u = u(Ricg +τK − 2K2 ) − LXK + 8πX(iJj). (10.6) Here (K2)ij = Ki kKkj, and parentheses denote averaged symmetrization. These equations extend smoothly to S. 3. On R × Int Mext the Lorentzian metric g = −u2 dt2 + gij( dxi + Xi dt)( dxj + Xj dt) (10.7) has stationary Killing field ξ = ∂t and induces (g, K) on t = 0, with future normal n = u−1(∂t − X) and the second fundamental form convention K = 1 2Lng. Its Einstein tensor satisfies uGij = −8πX(iJj), uµ + J(X) = 0. (10.8) Set N = u2 − |X|2. Then µN = 0, and, throughout this stationary spacetime, G = 8πµ u2 ξ♭ ⊗ ξ♭ , Scalg = 0, Ricg(ξ, ·) = 0. (10.9) In particular, the spacetime is vacuum on {N > 0}. 4. With ν pointing into the exterior, X = uν, ∂νu + K(X, ν) = κ, κ = 1 4m on S. (10.10) For each i = 1, . . . , ℓ, either u > 0 everywhere on Si, or u = 0 everywhere on Si. This alter- native is made separately on each component; the constant κ is common to all components.
